name: PackRat Voice Panel
description:
PackRat Voice Panel turns your CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a live voice dashboard for Discord Desktop.

See the voice channel you are currently in, the people connected with you, and who is speaking without bringing Discord back to the foreground. Active speakers are highlighted and promoted so the conversation stays readable at a glance.

Touch controls put Mute and Deafen directly on XENEON Edge. The panel follows you automatically when you join, leave, or switch voice channels, with no Server ID or Channel ID setup.

The interface is tuned for all eight XENEON Edge layouts, from compact horizontal and vertical slots through XL. Larger layouts add more roster space and recent speaking activity while smaller layouts keep the core channel, roster, and controls easy to read and touch.

PackRat Voice Panel requires the free PackRat Voice Bridge companion for Stream Deck and Discord Desktop on Windows. The companion handles the Discord connection locally on your PC and sends only normalized voice state to the XENEON widget over localhost. Discord access credentials are never sent to the XENEON widget.

PackRat Voice Panel is an independent third-party product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Discord Inc. Discord is a trademark of Discord Inc.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Initial release. Live current voice channel for Discord Desktop, member roster, active speaker highlighting and promotion, automatic channel following, touch Mute and Deafen controls, recent speaking activity on XL, appearance controls, and tuned support for all eight XENEON Edge layouts. Requires the free PackRat Voice Bridge companion for Stream Deck on Windows.
